shards.note: The engine's document-store shards keep one EntangledHVec per id (no superposition); remove() drops the map entry, removes the id's postings from the inverted index and invalidates the IVF/NSG snapshots, so deletion there is already exact. Counter bundles apply to the engine's superposition stores (bloom / counting-bloom / composite memories), which have no delete today.
